property_summary: For every call to transfer with a non-empty _tos, the reference contract reverts the whole transfer if any external transferFrom call to caddress fails (i.e., transfer never returns true when a callee reverts); the mutant that drops the require will return true even when a callee call fails, violating this safety property.
change_summary: Remove the require that the external call succeeded, so failed calls do not revert; transfer returns true even if a callee call returned false.
